digest.component_or_area: plan-review and material-pin lifecycle enforcement for rebar project
propositions: Enable both verify.enforce_plan_material_pins and verify.require_plan_review_for_close in rebar.toml while keeping library defaults false, preserving backward compatibility for legacy unpinned attestations.
Prove direct and transitive invalidation occurs only after actual material changes, including depends_on and blocks normalization to canonical prerequisites.

Demonstrate unchanged successful re-review produces no downstream propagation, in-progress self-edits require fresh execution review, and return-to-open reset behavior through public lifecycle surfaces.

Verify enable, disable, re-enable cycles; deleted and archived pinned target handling; and concurrent review/close operations without eager backfill, graph invalidation events, or stored relation migrations.

Validate four real CLI gates with no dry-run bypass: legacy unpinned claim succeeds, current pinned close succeeds, stale pin drift rejects with canonical target name, and missing close-plan review rejects with review-plan remediation instruction.
Complete end-to-end lifecycle interface test suite and provide structured JSON evidence with deterministic pass rule covering exit codes, status transitions, and reason tokens.
